sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.,Abhishek Tandon,Ashima Goel,Manu Srivastava Hon'ble Vivek Kumar Birla,J.
Hon'ble Anish Kumar Gupta,J.
Heard Ms. Kriti Gupta, Advocate holding brief of Sri Rohan Gupta, learned counsel for the petitioner as well as learned AGA appearing for the State respondents and perused the record.

The petitioner, by means of this writ petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, has invoked the jurisdiction of this Court with prayer to quash the impugned First Information Report dated 09.08.2023 registered as Case Crime No. 133 of 2023, under Sections 420, 406, 467, 467, 471,
506 IPC, Police Station Swaroop Nagar, District Central (Commissionerate Kanpur Nagar).

sentences.text: Both the parties are agreed to settle the dispute amicably and for the purpose of that a formal agreement between the parties has been submitted.
A copy of the notary affidavit has been annexed with the supplementary affidavit.

It is submitted by learned counsel for the both the parties that the matter may be amicably settled by way of mediation and conciliation, therefore, the matter may be referred to the Mediation and Conciliation Centre of this Court.
In view of the above, petitioner shall deposit a sum of Rs. 50,000/- within ten days from today with the Mediation Centre, which shall be retained by the Mediation Centre as mediation fee.
The matter is remitted to the Mediation Centre.

with the direction that after deposit of such amount,
by the petitioner, the mediation centre shall make all possible efforts to conclude the mediation by the next date fixed.
Both the parties are directed to appear before Mediation Center on 08.10.2023.
Put up this case on 16.10.2023 as fresh before the appropriate Bench along with the report of Mediation Centre.
Till the next date of listing, no coercive action shall be taken against the petitioner in the above mentioned case.
It is made clear that in case there occurs default by the petitioner either in depositing the amount or in appearing before the Mediation Centre.
on the date fixed, the interim order shall cease to operate and the Mediation Centre.
shall immediately communicate with the office which in turn shall list the case within a week before the appropriate Bench for passing orders in the matter.

Order Date :- 19.9.2023 Ashish Pd.
